close_reason: Fixed: added Mdn::new(disposition) constructor to jmap-mail-types/src/mdn.rs; doc comment updated
description: Mdn is #[non_exhaustive] and has no pub constructor. Any code outside jmap-mail-types that needs to build an Mdn (test harnesses, backend impls) must serialize to JSON and deserialize back, as seen in both send_mdns (step 7) and parse_mdns in MemoryBackend. This pattern is fragile — if Mdn gains a required field with no serde default, the JSON round-trip silently breaks. The right fix is a pub Mdn::new() constructor or builder in jmap-mail-types that is the authoritative construction path, and is updated when fields change.
title: Mdn has no constructor — #[non_exhaustive] forces all out-of-crate code to use JSON round-trip
